info.title: Village agent surface
info.description: The routes a member's own agent may call with a personal access token (Bearer vat_...). Reads return exactly what the member sees on the web; the two writes are confirmed in two calls and nothing is written before the member says yes.

agentToken.description: A vat_ token minted in the member's profile under Your agent. Honoured under /api/agent/v1 only.

kind.description: gathering, festival, sky, cycle-mark, ... (the one calendar's kinds)

occurrenceKey.description: Which occurrence of a recurring row; empty for a one-off. Send it back on the RSVP.
For a recurring gathering, which evening (village-time YYYY-MM-DD, from the calendar item). Null for a one-off.

error.description: missing | malformed | bad_signature | expired | wrong_action | wrong_holder | echo_mismatch, or a plain sentence

get.summary: The skills this village ships, by name and URL. Public.
The calendar the member sees. Scope calendar.read.

parameters.name: structure
parameters.description: Only gatherings at one map structure.

get.summary: One gathering with its schema.org markup. Scope calendar.read.
Circles and seats, and who holds them at the tier the member may see. Scope directory.read.

200.description: {circles, roles}. roles[].holders is empty when the member may not see people: that is a hidden field.

get.summary: Up to ten members by first name or handle. Scope directory.read.
The member's own profile sheet. Scope me.read.
The calendar cut to gatherings the member has answered. Scope me.read.

post.summary: Answer a gathering. Two calls: the first answers 202 with an echo and a confirmToken; the second, with confirm: true, the token and the unchanged echo, writes. Scope rsvp.write.

occurrenceKey.description: Required for a recurring gathering: the item's occurrenceKey from the calendar read.

202.description: Confirm required. Show the echo, get a yes, send it back.

403.description: RSVPs closed, the member cannot RSVP yet, or scope missing

404.description: not found, or the events module is off

409.description: Refused: missing, expired, echo_mismatch, wrong_holder, wrong_action; or full / not_open. Nothing was written.

post.summary: Post an intent, same two-call shape. Scope intents.write. 404 until the village opens introductions to agents.

get.summary: The brief for drafting the village map from its masterplan: the method (markdown), the rules, the masterplan link, where the village stands, the scene schema with an example, the live version and any draft waiting. Scope map.draft; the holder must be able to draft the map.

200.description: {method, rules, masterplan, ground, schema, live, draft, submit, reviewUrl}

403.description: scope missing, or map_edit_required: the holder may not draft the map

post.summary: Keep a drafted scene as the holder's own draft. Two calls: the first checks it and answers 202 with an echo and a confirmToken; the second, with confirm: true, the token and the unchanged echo, writes. Nothing is published: the founder reviews the draft on the map and publishes it. Scope map.draft.

scene.description: The scene, as an object or its JSON text. Shape and rules: GET /api/agent/v1/map.

echo.description: {sceneSha256, buildings, features, flows, changes, liveVersion, replaces}

202.description: Confirm required. Show the echo, get a yes, send it back.

200.description: {success: true, echo, reviewUrl}: kept as the holder's draft

400.description: draft_refused with every problem listed, scene_required or scene_not_json. Nothing was written.

409.description: Refused: missing, expired, echo_mismatch, wrong_holder, wrong_action. Nothing was written.
